title: Mods installer: offer each mod like the status line, installed at user scope on the person's yes
seam: orion.sh (mod parts), orion.ps1, tests/run.sh, .github/workflows/release.yml, CLAUDE.md, docs/guide/index.html
story: orion can now offer its optional mods, starting with Orion Control Tower, much like it offers the status bar. Every project carries orion's copy as an archive, but a computer gets a mod only when the person says yes, at setup or later with one command. When a project brings a newer version of an installed mod, the session start asks whether to take or skip it; removing orion leaves mods alone, and one command removes a mod for good.

checks.criterion: After init, the project holds orion's copy of each mod, listed in the manifest; nothing outside the project changed
checks.steps: Make an empty git folder. Run bash orion.sh init --project <folder> --yes --no-statusline --update-mode off from an orion checkout.
checks.expected: <folder>/.claude/orion/mods/control-tower.tar exists, .claude/orion/.orion-manifest lists it, no loose .ts/.tsx/.js/.json under .claude/orion/mods, and ~/.claude/orion-mods does not exist.

checks.criterion: The install sub-command creates the marketplace folder, installs at user scope and records the version taken
checks.steps: In that project run bash .claude/orion/orion.sh mod install control-tower.
checks.expected: A line saying the mod is installed for this computer from ~/.claude/orion-mods; ~/.claude/orion-mods/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json lists ./control-tower; claude plugin list shows control-tower@orion-mods.

checks.criterion: check offers a newer mod once, never a lower or skipped version, and is silent when copies match
checks.steps: After installing run orion.sh check; then raise line 5 of .claude/orion/VERSION and change a file inside the mod archive, run check; then run mod skip control-tower and check again.
checks.expected: Nothing first; then one JSON line naming mod install control-tower; nothing after the skip.

checks.criterion: orion uninstall leaves the computer's copy; mod remove deletes it and uninstalls the plugin
checks.steps: Run orion.sh uninstall --yes in the project, then orion.sh mod remove control-tower from an orion checkout.
checks.expected: After uninstall ~/.claude/orion-mods/control-tower still exists; after remove it says the mod is uninstalled and its copy deleted, and claude plugin list no longer shows it.

checks.criterion: The guide page has the mods tile and the install line
checks.expected: A tile 'The mods (optional)' naming ~/.claude/orion-mods, mod install, mod skip, mod remove and /control-tower, and an install-steps line about --mods.
